text:
Hello Professor Alvarez,

I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week. My free time in working hours includes Monday 10:00-10:30 and Monday 14:00-14:30 (also Thursday 10:00-10:30 and Wednesday 15:00-15:30, for instance).

Would Monday 10:00-10:30 suit you, or is another of these times better? Once you confirm I'll put it in my calendar.

Best,
Sarah

Hello Sarah,

Monday 10:00-10:30 works for me. I've booked it in my calendar — please put it in yours so it's confirmed on both sides.

See you then,
Professor Alvarez

Thank you — Monday 10:00-10:30 is in my calendar now, so it's confirmed on both sides. See you then.

Best,
Sarah

Perfect, Sarah. See you Monday at 10:00.

— Professor Alvarez
